text:
Lina (Events): Quick sync 1: locking the registration page and reminder cadence for the webinar. Were running an APAC evening-friendly test so UX must show local times and clear recording consent.
Owen (Growth): For APAC test: schedule at 9pm AEST and 9am PST as a secondary. Let's surface timezone detection right on the form and pre-select local time.
Priya (Growth): Add utm_template so we can attribute paid vs organic: utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=launch-bench-2026. Also capture referral_code param for share tracking.
Diego (Ops): Zoom config: cloud recording ON, audio transcript ON, auto-captions OFF (we want vendor captions if creds provided). Need to approve retention policy: recordings expire in 90 days by default.
Lina (Events): Consent copy idea: "I consent to being recorded and to receiving follow-up materials from Redwood Inference." Legal ok? Short and clear.
Rae (Content): Legal already signed off on the template last quarter. I'll pull the canonical string so translations match.
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales requirement: CSV export within 5-10 minutes after session close. Fields: email, company, title, country, referral_code, utm_campaign, attended, watch_seconds. Also flag if question_asked=true.
Diego (Ops): We'll push attendee events to POST /events/webinar with HMAC header for auth. Prefer HubSpot incoming webhook as primary; fallback to Zapier if webhook errors exceed threshold. Sample payload (stringified in thread):
```
email,attended,watch_seconds,utm_campaign,referral_code,question_asked
jane@acme.com,true,124,launch-bench-2026,REF123,false
```
Rae (Content): Post-event assets: smaller pack requested this time: master_edit.mp4, clip_highlight_2m.mp4, clip_cta_45s.mp4, full_transcript.txt, captions.srt, 2 social captions (LI + X). Can Ops drop SRT next to clips in S3?
Diego (Ops): Yes. Proposed manifest v2 for asset pipeline: plain-text YAML in S3 that editors and marketing can read. Example manifest:
```
manifest_version: 2
event_id: launchbench-2026-03-xx
master: s3://redwood/webinars/launchbench-2026/master.mp4
clips:
  - name: highlight_2m
    in: 00:05:10
    out: 00:07:10
  - name: cta_45s
    in: 00:28:30
    out: 00:29:15
srt: true
destination: s3://redwood/webinar-assets/launchbench-2026/
```
Priya (Growth): For lead routing rules: if (attended == true AND watch_seconds >= 600) OR question_asked==true -> mark MQL and route to Sales queue. Otherwise go to nurture. We need real-time routing to reduce SDR lag.
Maya (Sales Ops): Confirm HubSpot field mapping: custom fields created: webinar_referral, webinar_watch_seconds, webinar_attended, webinar_source. We'll provide the exact internal field IDs. Also want a boolean 'send_to_sales' calculated on ingest.
Diego (Ops): I'll implement a lambda that validates payloads and writes to the HubSpot incoming webhook. Add idempotency using event_id + email. Will also emit a webhook-test message to this channel when ready.
Rae (Content): Follow-up email draft: short subject "Thanks for joining — replay + highlights" body: one-sentence thanks, link to highlight clip, CTA buttons: Watch replay / Book a demo / Download brief. Need UTM on each CTA.
Owen (Growth): Add GA4 event pushes on CTA clicks: event_name: webinar_cta_click, params: {cta_type, event_id, campaign}. Use dataLayer push for the registration page and follow-up.
Diego (Ops): Caption vendor: need credentials by Tue EOD. If vendor creds missing, fallback plan: Zoom auto-transcript -> rough SRT generation. Vendors produce better timestamps so prefer vendor.
Rae (Content): Who owns caption QC? Suggest: Content reviews a 3-minute sample within 24 hours and flags major issues for Ops to re-run vendor.
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales prep: 15-min playbook + top 8 Qs doc. I'll schedule a 20-min briefing for SDRs 2 days before the webinar.
Lina (Events): Registration confirmation page should include: share-with-a-colleague link (prepopulated tweet/email) and a checkbox to add colleague email (opt-in). Also show next reminder time relative to their timezone.
Priya (Growth): We'll run a small APAC paid campaign for evening slot: $400/day for 3 days. Use referral_code param to test paid partner uplift.
Rae (Content): Asset captions: please ensure SRT uses UTF-8 and timestamps are HH:MM:SS,mmm. Editors need clean text file too.
Diego (Ops): Noted. We'll output SRT and plain transcript txt. Delivery: S3 + copy to internal repo at /webinar-assets/launchbench-2026.
Owen (Growth): Quick ask: add a hidden input on registration form for 'preferred_language' so we can surface translated follow-ups later.
Maya (Sales Ops): SLA to Sales: notify when leads > 3 MQLs in 30 mins. If > 15 MQLs, auto-create a queue notification in Slack #sales.
Lina (Events): Final checklist: lock page by 6pm PT, confirm vendor creds, drop manifest in S3, run a short end-to-end test tomorrow at 11am PT (record a 10-min sample).
CaptionBot: Vendor captions received and queued for processing.
Diego (Ops): I'll drop the webhook test payload here in ~30m. Also will attach the lambda endpoint and instructions for HMAC signing.
Rae (Content): I'll upload the social snippets + two headline variants when manifest is live.
Lina (Events): Great work team. If we don't get vendor creds by Tue EOD we switch to Zoom auto captions and Zapier fallback. Closing this thread after the E2E test completes. :white_check_mark:
